body:
# deepseek

a sourced history of deepseek, the open-weights ai lab, its founder liang wenfeng, and high-flyer, the hedge fund behind it.

deepseek looks like it appeared in january 2025, when r1 took the top of the app store and ~$589b off nvidia in a day. it didn't — it is the research arm of high-flyer, a hangzhou quant fund that spent a decade building an ai trading firm and bought ~10,000 nvidia a100s before the export controls arrived. this is the record of the whale behind the lab: the classmates who automated trading from their dorms, the fund's peak and public apology, the fire-flyer clusters, the open-weights doctrine, the shock, the scrutiny, and the first raise that made the disruptor an incumbent.

- [history](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history): the company, sourced and dated — from the dorm-room trading bots to fire-flyer ii, the r1 shock, and the first raise.
  - [the classmates](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#origins): 2008–2015 — automated trading from the zju dorms, jacobi, and the fund's registration.
  - [the ai fund](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#quant): 2016–2021 — the ai fund: deep-learning trades, the golden bull, the ~rmb 100b peak, and the apology.
  - [the fleet](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#compute): 2021–2023 — fire-flyer ii's ~10,000 a100s, bought before the october 2022 controls; the agi pivot.
  - [the lab](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#lab): 2023–2024 — incorporation, the release ladder, grpo, the v2 price war, and v3's 2.788m-gpu-hour run.
  - [the shock](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#shock): january–march 2025 — r1, the app-store #1, the nvidia crash, the bans, and the symposiums.
  - [the scrutiny](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#scrutiny): 2025 — passports, the stalled r2, the ascend failure, the nature paper, and the poached bench.
  - [the incumbent](https://hraness.com/deepseek/history#incumbent): 2026– — the first raise, v4, the price hike, ipo prep, and r2 never shipped.
- [people](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people): liang wenfeng and the people around both companies — the zju classmates, the fund's partners, the research bench, and the diaspora.
  - [the founder](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people#founder): liang wenfeng — the quant who codes, co-author on the papers, 'an ordinary little pig,' and the richest ai founder.
  - [the writing](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people#writing): the corpus — the golden bull speech, the two 暗涌 interviews, the technical reports, and the leaked investor call.
  - [the team](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people#team): the partners and the bench — xu jin, zheng dawei, chen zhe, li huan, lu zhengzhe, the first cfo, and the ~300-author research org.
  - [interviews and talks](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people#appearances): the interviews and talks — two 暗涌 sittings and one forum speech are nearly the whole public record.
  - [the philosophy](https://hraness.com/deepseek/people#philosophy): technological idealism, open weights as strategy, constraint as engine — and the people-level controversies.
- [side quests](https://hraness.com/deepseek/side-quests): the pursuits around the flagship — the philanthropy, the compute-donation program, the edge model lines, open source week, and the raise.
  - [the founders' quests](https://hraness.com/deepseek/side-quests#founders): 'an ordinary little pig' — liang's pseudonymous philanthropy and the founders' quests.
  - [the lab's quests](https://hraness.com/deepseek/side-quests#lab): the compute-donation program, open source week, the consumer app, the ascend hedge, r2, the ipo track, and the fund that keeps earning.
  - [the bench's quests](https://hraness.com/deepseek/side-quests#bench): the researchers' lines — grpo, prover, math-v2, and the vl2/janus multimodal work.
- [coverage](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage): what the discourse made of deepseek — the sputnik week, the crash, the bans, the censorship and chip sourcing debates, and the incumbent turn.
  - [the discovery](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#discovery): the invisible giant — the 暗涌 interviews, the price war the west missed, and v3's technical-report notice.
  - [the awe](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#awe): the sputnik post, #1 over chatgpt in 52 countries, and the origin-story profiles.
  - [the panic](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#panic): the crash, the jevons counter, the meta war rooms, and the $1b–$150b valuation debate.
  - [the chips](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#chips): the silicon question — semianalysis's 50k-gpu estimate, the commerce probe, the smuggling trail, and the h20 squeeze.
  - [the bans](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#bans): italy first, then the us cascade — navy, nasa, texas, h.r.1121 — and the global map.
  - [the censorship](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#censorship): the refusal strings, the self-censoring stream, the weights-level findings, and the hosted-serving counterweight.
  - [the security](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#security): the open database, the jailbreak findings, and the app forensics.
  - [the counter-takes](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#skepticism): the distillation claims, the cost teardown, and the 'optimization, not revolution' counter-takes.
  - [the state](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#state): the symposiums, the house report, the passport story — state adjacency as the coverage frame.
  - [the year after](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#aftermath): the year after — the panic post-mortem, the peer-review precedent, the second deepseek moment, and the incumbent turn.
  - [controversies](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#controversies): the running debates — the cost number, distillation, chip sourcing, layered censorship, the security week, and the valuation fog.
  - [sentiment eras](https://hraness.com/deepseek/coverage#eras): sentiment phases: invisible giant → sputnik week → panic → scrutiny → incumbent.
- [the idea](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea): the whale-funds-the-lab model — the lineage deepseek inherited, what it proved, and what it left unresolved.
  - [lineage](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#lineage): the renaissance template, the zju network, the fund as patron, infrastructure first, and the embargo as engine.
  - [what deepseek proved](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#proved): what the model demonstrated — patronage, constraint-engineered efficiency, open weights as distribution, pricing as a weapon.
  - [what stayed unfinished](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#stalled): r2, the ascend wall, research meeting revenue, the end of pure patronage, and the poached bench.
  - [the arguments](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#arguments): whether the pattern is portable, whether openness is the moat or the exposure, and what the state adjacency costs.
  - [successors](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#successors): kimi, qwen, zhipu, minimax, mistral — and meta's llama as the patron who retreated.
  - [open questions](https://hraness.com/deepseek/the-idea#open-questions): the questions the next year has to answer.
- [sources](https://hraness.com/deepseek/sources): every source cited in the deepseek history, with its date and type.
  - [the catalog](https://hraness.com/deepseek/sources#catalog): the full typed catalog — primary, interview, reporting, archive, community, repo, reference.
- [method](https://hraness.com/deepseek/method): how ai agents researched the deepseek history, the evidence rules they followed, and what they could not verify.
  - [the lanes](https://hraness.com/deepseek/method#lanes): the two parallel research lanes and what the formula proved.
  - [the evidence rules](https://hraness.com/deepseek/method#rules): the evidence model — confidence, precision, sentiment discipline.
  - [known gaps](https://hraness.com/deepseek/method#gaps): what the research could not verify — recorded, not hidden.
  - [corrections](https://hraness.com/deepseek/method#corrections): how to correct the record.

AI-drafted at Ben Guo's direct request and credited to Hraness; every claim links to its cataloged source.
